Export picks

Four codes, one per line: N: = NZB sires, K: = Keeneland sires, R: = race names, V: = review decisions (s = new options please, o = own name). Copy all four lines and send them to the session.

📤 Send to Claude

Import code

Paste an exported code. Lines starting N: go to NZB, K: to Keeneland, R: to the race names, V: to the review decisions. Its picks replace the picks for the same sires here. A code with no prefix is read as NZB, only on the NZB tab.
